tessan.title: Tessan internship — GenAI × fullstack

unet.pitch: Semantic segmentation model on high-resolution satellite imagery. Preprocessing, supervised training, IoU/Dice evaluation. Reproducible pipeline, commented notebooks.

ecg.title: ECG classification — MLP · CNN · RNN
ecg.pitch: Heart attack detection on ECG signals. Three architectures compared, hyperparameter tuning, delivered to a cardiology department.

prepa.text: Science-track baccalaureate, then two years of intensive prep school in math, physics, chemistry, and computer science.

ensisa.text: Admitted to ENSISA (École Nationale Supérieure d'Ingénieurs Sud-Alsace), branch Computer Science and Networks, through France's national engineering competitive exams.

kyoto.text: Final year of studies as an exchange student at Kyoto Institute of Technology, Japan.

tessan.text: Final-year internship as AI project lead at Tessan, a French telemedicine company.

conviction.label: conviction
conviction.body: I believe in AI that serves and augments humans — not the kind that replaces them. That conviction shapes what I want to build, and who for. Ready to put my skills to work on products worth building.
